scope: Restore worked-solution visibility on GitHub Pages without requiring the local service for unchanged public beam examples.
reviewer: Implementation agent self-review, not independent review
cause: The worked panel returned early whenever the verification service was disconnected. The public page had no service URL.

behaviour_review.public_examples_only: The generator reads the three maintained synthetic models from the browser factory. It does not read student records.
behaviour_review.certificate_scope: All nine exported source hashes agree with existing checked CI receipts. The full model and exact section must agree before a published response is displayed.
behaviour_review.stale_results: Browser checks confirmed that changing a load immediately removes the checked badge and derivation. An unlisted section displays a clear message and the available section buttons.
behaviour_review.privacy: No CORS, credentials, compiler settings, or record-service permissions changed. Transfer to the local workspace uses the existing explicit model export/import controls.
behaviour_review.practice: The existing reveal gate and recording callback are preserved. Published solutions do not mark queued answers as graded.

readability_review.guide: author-style code-style.md 0.2; proportionate UI/documentation prose review under author-style 0.27
readability_review.result: Example selection and loading are isolated in a small module. Exact model comparison preserves every field and array order. The existing worked renderer retains all methods and verification-scope text.
readability_review.prose: The panel distinguishes published examples from edited beams and explains the local-workspace route. README documents availability and generation without claiming browser-based Lean execution.

validation.node_tests: 31 passed, including three new published-solution regression tests
validation.browser: Static preview without API: beam key quantities and double integration displayed, quarter-section selection updated the certificate, unsupported section and edited load cleared the result, distributed-load example displayed.
validation.equation_rendering: Double integration rendered 40 KaTeX expressions with zero math errors and no page overflow.
validation.local_lean: Not executed. Existing exact-source receipts were reused for local preview. Deployment checks remain on Linux CI.
